thread:
alex: Quick sanity sweep before the quiet window starting 22:00 UTC. Can folks confirm pin approvals + rollback plan? I want any freeze-exempt ops called out now.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change window: 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC -> 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC. Auto-canary enabled. Rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m holds.

lena: I approved the feature flags in config. Pin request for model version rdx-3.0.1 and API surface v1.9 is in PR #482. :white_check_mark:

mai: I reviewed the PR. CI passed except one flaky embedding test. QA will run extra smoke on staging at 20:30 UTC. If that fails we hold and don’t pin.

ciqa: Smoke checklist: health endpoints, token quota checks, streaming latencies, embedding correctness sample. ETA 21:10 UTC for full run.

sre: Oncall and I discussed rollback. Plan: immediate traffic shift to fallback pool (rdx-2.x) via routing rule, and cancel canary if error rate > 3% or p95 latency regresses by >200ms for 3 consecutive checks. Playbook pinned below.

ben-oncall: +1 to that. Also pre-warm fallback capacity to avoid cold-start latencies. I'll run the prewarm at 21:45 UTC.

alex: Can we record the exact pin command so ops can run it quickly?

mai: Use this: ```
redwoodctl rollout pin --model rdx-3.0.1 --config v1.9 --reason "Q2 launch pin" --by lena
```

alex: Perfect. Who signs off on exemptions? We had one customer-facing embeddings tweak flagged as high-risk — does it get an exemption?

lena: Not without a regression run. If QA passes and we have a mitigation (auto-fallback to rdx-2.x for embedding endpoints only), I will approve a scoped exemption limited to 30 minutes post-rollout.

ciqa: Note: embeddings cost limiter will be disabled briefly for the canary to measure cost impact. We will re-enable after 30m and compare. Documenting metrics: cost/sec, median embed latency, error rate.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create rollback ticket if manual intervention needed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ops/ROLLBACK-2026-0319

alex: Action items summarised: 1) @ciqa run smoke at 20:30 (21:10 full run) 2) @ben-oncall prewarm fallback at 21:45 3) @lena final signoff if smoke clean 4) @mai execute pin with command above at 21:55 UTC 5) deploy-bot will start canary 22:00 UTC. If any item fails, halt.

mai: I'll post a short announce to #general once canary hits 5% and on full rollout.

ben-oncall: I'll put pager watch on for the first 90 minutes. If I see >3% errors I will shift traffic back manually.

alex: Thanks all. If no objections by 21:30 UTC we proceed with the plan. :thumbsup:

lena: No objections from me.

ciqa: No further blocks from QA.

sre: All set here. I'll attach the short rollback play in the ticket.

alex: Closing thread — proceeding to quiet window prep.
